category_title: Adolescents who disengage due to perceived teacher indifference and lack of individual support
minimal_context: The student is given a worksheet with repeated problems to complete in a classroom setting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your next worksheet. It has the same type of problems we did yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: School just became boring. I don’t learn normal, like normal people.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Since I have like learning disabilities, abilities, whatever you wanna call it, I can’t do repeated work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please try your best to finish the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just gonna sit here. I just kinda stopped doing it.
